class.name: HTMLTableElement
class.brief_description: An HTML table with row and section editing.
class.description: Create tables with [method HTMLLayout.create_element] or query them by selector. Table edits operate on the current layout. Collections are typed array snapshots. Removed sections and rows retain their handles.

method.name: create_caption
method.description: Returns the existing caption or creates it.

method.name: create_t_body
method.description: Creates a table body after the last existing body, or appends it if there are no bodies.

method.name: create_t_foot
method.description: Returns the existing table foot or creates it.

method.name: create_t_head
method.description: Returns the existing table head or creates it.

method.name: delete_caption
method.description: Detaches the first direct caption, if present.

method.name: delete_row
method.description: Detaches the row at the given index and preserves its handle. Pass [code]-1[/code] to detach the last row. Returns [constant OK] if the list is empty and the index is [code]-1[/code].

method.name: delete_t_foot
method.description: Detaches the first direct table foot, if present.

method.name: delete_t_head
method.description: Detaches the first direct table head, if present.

method.name: get_rows
method.description: Returns a snapshot with head rows first, followed by body and direct rows, then foot rows.

method.name: get_t_bodies
method.description: Returns a tree-order snapshot of the immediate table bodies.

method.name: insert_row
method.description: Inserts a row in the target row's parent. An empty table uses its last body or creates one. Pass [code]-1[/code] to append. Returns [code]null[/code] for an invalid index.

members.member: The first direct caption. Setting this to [code]null[/code] detaches it.
The first direct table foot. Assign a [code]<tfoot>[/code] handle from the same layout or [code]null[/code].
The first direct table head. Assign a [code]<thead>[/code] handle from the same layout or [code]null[/code].
